data.action: 侧卧竹林石台锦垫，一手轻勾画面外同伴衣角，散落酒盏在身旁。
data.description: 月下竹林的石台上铺着锦垫，酒盏东倒西歪。全裸的令半醉半醒地侧卧在锦垫上，脸颊浮着薄红，龙角沾着夜色，蓝发散落在竹叶间。她伸手勾住你的衣角，声音软得像化开的酒——「今夜月色这么好……陪我再喝一杯，好不好？」
data.lighting: moonlight filtered through bamboo leaves, dappled silver shadows, soft mist
data.promptProse: Ling lies on her side on the cushioned stone platform, catching her off-frame companion's sleeve beside scattered wine cups. Moonlight through bamboo leaves breaks across the cushion and low mist.
data.title: 令 · 竹林微醺
data.animaCaption: She catches her off-frame companion's sleeve beside the scattered wine cups.
